lines.zh: 我在村里跑，砖缝里的草被我踩平。
lines.en: I run through the village and flatten the grass in the cracks.

lines.zh: 我沿着水渠走，数里面有几种虫。
lines.en: I follow the ditch and count how many kinds of bugs are in it.

lines.zh: 我绕村一圈，走到第七间屋就回头。
lines.en: I circle the village and turn back at the seventh house.

lines.zh: 我踮着脚走，怕吵醒门口打盹的。
lines.en: I tiptoe so I do not wake the one dozing in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子走，影子比我快。
lines.en: I walk on my own shadow, and it outruns me.

lines.zh: 我从广场走到村口，再走回来。
lines.en: I go from the square to the village gate and back again.

lines.zh: 我走路带跳，石板都被我跳熟了。
lines.en: I hop as I go, and I know every stone by hopping on it.

lines.zh: 我跟着一只鸡走了半条巷子。
lines.en: I follow a chicken halfway down the lane.

lines.zh: 我拖着一根木棍，地上划出长线。
lines.en: I drag a stick and leave a long line on the ground.

lines.zh: 我跑去银行门口看一眼，又跑了。
lines.en: I run to the bank door for one look, then run off.

lines.zh: 我走过晒谷场，鞋里进了沙子。
lines.en: I cross the drying yard and sand gets into my shoes.

lines.zh: 我走在大人的后面，走三步停一步。
lines.en: I walk behind the grown-ups, three steps then one pause.

lines.zh: 我从墙头走，比走地面快得多。
lines.en: I walk along the wall top, which is much faster than the ground.

lines.zh: 我走到村尾，那里有条没人的路。
lines.en: I walk to the end of the village, where a road has no people.

lines.zh: 我蹲在墙根，看蚂蚁搬一粒米。
lines.en: I squat by the wall and watch ants carry a grain of rice.

lines.zh: 我把石子摆成一排，当它们是兵。
lines.en: I line up pebbles and pretend they are soldiers.

lines.zh: 我数屋檐下的燕子窝，有三个。
lines.en: I count the swallow nests under the eaves; there are three.

lines.zh: 我坐着晃腿，晃到腿麻了才停。
lines.en: I sit swinging my legs until they go numb.

lines.zh: 我在等大人叫我吃饭，等得有点久。
lines.en: I am waiting to be called for dinner, and it has been a while.

lines.zh: 我把脸贴在凉石头上，很舒服。
lines.en: I press my cheek to the cool stone, which feels good.

lines.zh: 我听见钟响，可我不用去上班。
lines.en: I hear the bell, and I do not have to go to work.

lines.zh: 我在沙地上画圈，画完又抹掉。
lines.en: I draw circles in the sand and rub them out again.

lines.zh: 我看着水缸里的自己，做个鬼脸。
lines.en: I look at myself in the water jar and pull a face.

lines.zh: 我把口袋翻过来，只有两颗石子。
lines.en: I turn my pockets out and find only two pebbles.

lines.zh: 我在门口打哈欠，眼泪都出来了。
lines.en: I yawn in the doorway until my eyes water.

lines.zh: 我把木棍插在土里，等它长成树。
lines.en: I plant a stick and wait for it to become a tree.

lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，听巷子里谁在说话。
lines.en: I hold my breath to hear who is talking in the lane.

lines.zh: 我躺在草垛上，看云被风吹散。
lines.en: I lie on the haystack and watch the wind pull the clouds apart.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，你要比我高两个头。
lines.en: I look up; you are two heads taller than I am.

lines.zh: 你的靴子好大，能装下我两只脚。
lines.en: Your boots are huge enough to hold both of my feet.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼地看你，看到你先移开。
lines.en: I stare without blinking until you look away first.

lines.zh: 你身上有村外的味道，很陌生。
lines.en: You smell of somewhere outside the village, and it is strange.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，藏着我的石子。
lines.en: I put my hands behind my back and hide my pebbles.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，我往后退一步。
lines.en: When you bend down, I take one step back.

lines.zh: 我看你的剑，它比我整个人还长。
lines.en: I look at your sword; it is longer than I am tall.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，然后等你回话。
lines.en: I call out once and then wait for you to answer.

lines.zh: 我从门缝里看你，以为你发现不了。
lines.en: I watch you through the door crack, sure you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓鼓的，我很好奇。
lines.en: Your pocket is bulging, and I am very curious.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一个走错路的人。
lines.en: I look at you like someone who took the wrong road.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我就不那么怕了。
lines.en: You smiled, so I am less afraid than before.

lines.zh: 我踮脚比了比，还是差一大截。
lines.en: I stand on tiptoe to compare, and you are still far above me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，怕你摸我的头。
lines.en: I watch your hand, afraid it will pat my head.

lines.zh: 我躲在砖堆后面，只露出一只眼。
lines.en: I hide behind the brick pile with one eye showing.

lines.zh: 你朝这边看，我装作在数石头。
lines.en: You look this way, so I pretend to count stones.

lines.zh: 你弄疼我了，我要告诉大人。
lines.en: You hurt me, and I am telling a grown-up.

lines.zh: 我坐在地上，眼泪自己掉下来。
lines.en: I sit on the ground and the tears come by themselves.

lines.zh: 我捂着手臂，那里红了一块。
lines.en: I hold my arm, where a red mark has come up.

lines.zh: 我没哭出声，只是抽气。
lines.en: I do not cry aloud; I only gasp.

lines.zh: 我跑开了，跑进最近的一间屋。
lines.en: I run off into the nearest house.

lines.zh: 我揉着膝盖，嘴里念着不疼。
lines.en: I rub my knee and keep saying it does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你比我大那么多，我打不过你。
lines.en: You are so much bigger, and I cannot fight you.

lines.zh: 我躲到水缸后面，等你走开。
lines.en: I hide behind the water jar until you go.

lines.zh: 我吸着鼻子，把眼泪擦在袖子上。
lines.en: I sniff and wipe my tears on my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，声音在巷子里转两圈。
lines.en: I cry out, and the sound circles the lane twice.

lines.zh: 你手里那块糖，我只在集市见过。
lines.en: I have seen that sweet only once, at the market.

lines.zh: 我帮你拿东西，只要一点点吃的。
lines.en: I will carry your things for just a little food.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，一小口就够了。
lines.en: I am not greedy; one small bite is enough.

lines.zh: 你把饼掰开，我的眼睛跟着动。
lines.en: You break the flatbread, and my eyes follow your hands.

lines.zh: 大人说不能要陌生人的东西。
lines.en: The grown-ups say not to take things from strangers.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，是甜的，真的很甜。
lines.en: I can smell it; it is sweet, truly sweet.

lines.zh: 我伸出手又缩回来，反复三次。
lines.en: I reach out and pull back, three times over.

lines.zh: 你要是给我，我带你去看水井。
lines.en: If you give it to me, I will show you the well.

lines.zh: 我肚子在叫，你别笑我。
lines.en: My stomach is growling, so do not laugh at me.

lines.zh: 我拿石子跟你换，行不行。
lines.en: I will trade you pebbles for it, will that do?

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我一屁股坐在地上。
lines.en: You bump me, and I land flat on the ground.

lines.zh: 我跑太快，撞在你腿上弹回去。
lines.en: I run too fast, hit your leg, and bounce back.

lines.zh: 我揉揉头，没哭，只是眼睛有点湿。
lines.en: I rub my head, not crying, just a little wet-eyed.

lines.zh: 你扶我起来，我拍拍裤子上的土。
lines.en: You help me up, and I dust off my trousers.

lines.zh: 我从你胳膊下面钻过去，像钻门。
lines.en: I duck under your arm the way I duck through a doorway.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，石子撒了一地。
lines.en: We collide, and my pebbles scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 我撞到门框，门框比我硬得多。
lines.en: I run into the door frame, which is much harder than me.

lines.zh: 你的包碰了我的脸，硬邦邦的。
lines.en: Your pack knocks my cheek, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 我退开时踩到了自己的脚。
lines.en: As I back away, I step on my own foot.

lines.zh: 我说了对不起，虽然是你撞的我。
lines.en: I say sorry, even though you bumped into me.

lines.zh: 我还小，没人跟我说这种事。
lines.en: I am still small, and nobody tells me about such things.

lines.zh: 隔壁的扎尔说，我以后有屋子。
lines.en: The Zal next door says I will have my own house someday.

lines.zh: 我看见两个大人在墙后说话。
lines.en: I saw two grown-ups talking behind the wall.

lines.zh: 他们说要给我找个伴，我不懂。
lines.en: They say they will find me a companion, and I do not understand.

lines.zh: 我最好的伙伴是巷口那只猫。
lines.en: My best companion is the cat at the lane's mouth.

lines.zh: 我们拉过手，那算不算数。
lines.en: We held hands once; does that count?

lines.zh: 我以后要娶谁，得先问大人。
lines.en: Who I marry later, I must ask the grown-ups first.

lines.zh: 大人笑我脸红，我根本没脸红。
lines.en: The grown-ups say I blushed, and I did not blush at all.

lines.zh: 我把石子分了一半给另一个小孩。
lines.en: I gave half my pebbles to another child.

lines.zh: 我还不懂成家，我只想接着玩。
lines.en: I do not understand households yet; I only want to keep playing.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗亮石子，装进左边口袋。
lines.en: I pick up a bright pebble and put it in my left pocket.

lines.zh: 地上有枚铜币，我交给了大人。
lines.en: I found a copper coin on the ground and gave it to a grown-up.

lines.zh: 我捡到一根羽毛，插在头发上。
lines.en: I found a feather and stuck it in my hair.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的木剑捡回家，还能用。
lines.en: I took a broken wooden sword home; it still works.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很快，蹲下就起来。
lines.en: I am quick at picking things up, down and up again.

lines.zh: 大人们说掉在地上的别乱捡。
lines.en: The grown-ups say do not pick up whatever lies on the ground.

lines.zh: 我捡到一个空瓶，可以装水。
lines.en: I found an empty bottle, and it can hold water.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的果子擦擦就咬。
lines.en: I wipe the fallen fruit on my sleeve and bite it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片碎瓦，它像个月牙。
lines.en: I pick up a shard of tile; it looks like a crescent moon.

lines.zh: 我捡的东西太多，口袋都坠歪。
lines.en: I have picked up so much that my pockets hang crooked.

lines.zh: 有陌生人进村，我躲到门后面。
lines.en: A stranger enters the village, and I hide behind the door.

lines.zh: 你不是村里的人，我一眼看出来。
lines.en: You are not from this village; I can tell at a glance.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，可大人们都在忙。
lines.en: I shout once, but the grown-ups are all busy.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，看你要进哪间屋。
lines.en: I watch to see which house you will enter.

lines.zh: 你要是碰水井，我就叫。
lines.en: If you touch the well, I will shout.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，隔得远远的。
lines.en: I follow you at a good distance.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，装作看天。
lines.en: You stop, so I stop and pretend to study the sky.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的帽子，很好认。
lines.en: I have memorized your hat; it is easy to spot.

lines.zh: 我从巷子另一头绕过去告诉大人。
lines.en: I go around by the other end of the lane to tell a grown-up.

lines.zh: 你进了村，我的游戏就结束了。
lines.en: You entered the village, and my game ended.

lines.zh: 我绕着你跑，跑得比你转得快。
lines.en: I run around you, faster than you can turn.

lines.zh: 我从左边探出头，又缩回去。
lines.en: I poke my head out on the left and pull it back.

lines.zh: 我扔了颗石子，扔歪了，在你脚边。
lines.en: I throw a pebble; it goes wide and lands at your feet.

lines.zh: 我等你低头，好从你身边溜过去。
lines.en: I wait for you to look down so I can slip past.

lines.zh: 你看着我，我就看地上的蚂蚁。
lines.en: When you look at me, I study the ants on the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，挪到大人身后就安全。
lines.en: I edge along until I am safely behind a grown-up.

lines.zh: 我把木棍举起来，其实不敢打。
lines.en: I raise the stick, though I do not dare swing it.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就退到墙根。
lines.en: The moment you raise a hand, I back to the wall.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，数到十就跑。
lines.en: I count your steps and run when I reach ten.

lines.zh: 我假装不在意，其实一直看你。
lines.en: I pretend not to care while watching you the whole time.

lines.zh: 我推了你一下，你几乎没动。
lines.en: I shove you, and you barely move.

lines.zh: 我用木棍敲你的腿，敲完就跑。
lines.en: I tap your leg with my stick and run.

lines.zh: 我扔石子，飞得比我想的还远。
lines.en: I throw a pebble, and it flies farther than I expected.

lines.zh: 我咬了你一口，然后自己先哭。
lines.en: I bite you and then start crying first.

lines.zh: 我踢你的靴子，疼的是我的脚。
lines.en: I kick your boot, and the pain is in my foot.

lines.zh: 我抓了一把沙，往你脸上扬。
lines.en: I scoop up sand and fling it at your face.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，可我还是打了。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, and still I hit you.

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝盖，像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: I butt your knee as if against a wall.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的手腕，我就挣扎。
lines.en: You grip my wrist, and I struggle.

lines.zh: 我一拳打空，差点自己摔倒。
lines.en: My punch misses, and I nearly fall over myself.

lines.zh: 我出生在这条巷子，屋里很挤。
lines.en: I was born in this lane, in a crowded house.

lines.zh: 村子很小，孩子不少，我是其中一个。
lines.en: The village is small and the children many, and I am one.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是屋檐和晾着的布。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was the eaves and hanging cloth.

lines.zh: 我会走以后，全村都是我的院子。
lines.en: Once I could walk, the whole village became my yard.

lines.zh: 大人说我出生那天雨很大。
lines.en: The grown-ups say it rained hard the day I was born.

lines.zh: 我从摇篮里爬出来，摔在草席上。
lines.en: I climbed out of the cradle and landed on the straw mat.

lines.zh: 这个村子离城很远，我就生在这里。
lines.en: This village is far from the city, and here I was born.

lines.zh: 我学会的第一句话是喊饿。
lines.en: The first words I learned were to cry that I was hungry.

lines.zh: 我出生时，银行的钟敲了一下。
lines.en: When I was born, the bank bell rang once.

lines.zh: 我在偏僻的村里长大，没见几个人。
lines.en: I grew up in a remote village and have met few people.

lines.zh: 锅里的火溅出来，烫到我的脚。
lines.en: Fire from the pot spits out and burns my foot.

lines.zh: 我从墙上摔下来，屁股先落地。
lines.en: I fall off the wall and land on my backside.

lines.zh: 水缸太深，我呛了一口水。
lines.en: The water jar is too deep, and I swallow a mouthful.

lines.zh: 响声把我掀倒，我趴着不敢动。
lines.en: The bang knocks me down, and I lie still, afraid to move.

lines.zh: 有东西擦过我的耳朵，很烫。
lines.en: Something grazes my ear, and it is hot.

lines.zh: 光一闪，我的头发全竖起来。
lines.en: The light flashes, and all my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 饭还没好，我的肚子一直叫。
lines.en: Dinner is not ready, and my stomach will not stop growling.

lines.zh: 打雷了，我钻进桌子底下。
lines.en: Thunder comes, and I crawl under the table.

lines.zh: 下面黑得没有底，我不敢看。
lines.en: The dark below has no bottom, and I dare not look.
